{{Top|leg|notoc=1}}
{{Quote|Freight in the entire sector's slow. The growing season on Coyn is over, nobody's buying electronics out of Torina&hellip; and Derilyn still being closed to most outside ships isn't helping much either.|A [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] at [[Gwynn Dispatch]]|<ref name="OE">[[Operation: Elrood (book)|''Operation: Elrood'']]</ref>}}
The '''growing season''' was a [[season/Legends|season]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Anobis]],<ref name="RtOM">''[[Young Jedi Knights: Return to Ord Mantell]]''</ref> [[Coyn]],<ref name="OE" /> [[Dilonexa XXIII]],<ref name="TEGtD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref> [[Draenell's Point]],<ref name="GK">''[[Star Wars Gamemaster Kit]]''</ref> [[Honoghr/Legends|Honoghr]],<ref name="TLC">''[[The Last Command]]''</ref> [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]],<ref name="Purgatory">''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Purgatory]]''</ref> [[Najiba/Legends|Najiba]],<ref name="TFE">{{JournalCite|4|The Final Exit}}</ref> [[Nubia/Legends|Nubia]],<ref name="CatCW">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref> [[Orron III]],<ref name="HSE">''[[Han Solo at Stars' End]]''</ref> [[Orto/Legends|Orto]],<ref name="GG4">''[[Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races]]''</ref> [[Pakrik Minor]],<ref name="SotP">''[[Specter of the Past]]''</ref> [[Pfertiuin 4]],<ref name="SF12">{{VoyagesCite|12|Hide and Go Seek}}</ref> [[Prishardia]],<ref name="ST">{{StoryCite|book=Tales from the New Republic|story=Simple Tricks}}</ref> [[Salliche/Legends|Salliche]],<ref name="TEGtD" /> [[Sileron]],<ref name="PotG1">''[[Planets of the Galaxy, Volume One]]''</ref> [[Socorro/Legends|Socorro]],<ref name="TBSoS">''[[The Black Sands of Socorro]]''</ref> [[Taanab/Legends|Taanab]],<ref name="TEGtD" /> [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]],<ref name="TJPT">''[[Star Wars Technical Journal of the Planet Tatooine]]''</ref> [[Toola/Legends|Toola]],<ref name="SWE">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> [[Toydaria/Legends|Toydaria]]<ref name="TNEGtC">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref> and [[Ukio/Legends|Ukio]],<ref name="TLCS">''[[The Last Command Sourcebook]]''</ref> and on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Yavin 13/Legends|Yavin 13]].<ref name="GG2">''[[Galaxy Guide 2: Yavin and Bespin]]''</ref>

The [[Agriworld/Legends|agricultural world]] Draenell's Point had a long [[Summer/Legends|summer]] growing season called "[[Thulpin]]" which lasted about fourteen [[Standard month/Legends|standard months]].<ref name="GK" />

The [[Desert/Legends|desert]] planet Tatooine had a growing season.<ref name="SP">{{JournalCite|11|Spare Parts (short story)}}</ref> Once each [[Local year|year]], the [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]] held a [[swap meet]] in the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]], the [[Great Swap Meet]],<ref name="TISWU">''[[The Illustrated Star Wars Universe]]''</ref> at the end of the growing season and before the start of the [[sandstorm season]].<ref name="SP" />
